sourceConfirmedUntestedIssue: Historical source-confirmed late destination validation: root implemented whole-set destination preflight before any mesh/catalog publication. No destructive shared-asset disk-failure reproduction was run.
status: Complete within bounded review: all 167 voxel cases pass in U15, including 42 initial review cases, 13 pitch preflight cases and six actual imported-art cases. The complete suite has the same 32 failing names and messages as U00; U11 native receipt remains a separate qualified gate.

actualRegenerationFinding.problem: Unity CreateAsset normalizes Mesh.name to the asset filename; a VX_Toolkit_ name ownership check wrongly rejected the earlier valid generated meshes.
actualRegenerationFinding.fix: Root replaced mutable name checking with AssetImporter.userData ownership tag CavesOfOoo.VoxelWorld.Toolkit/1; only the38 root-verified initial outputs were tagged.
actualRegenerationFinding.guidPreservationScope: Root reported GUIDs preserved during the38-file tag update; reviewer independently captured the post-U10 GUID baseline and verified all38 ownership tags.

importedArtTests.scope: Actual mesh coverage, toolkit geometry/provenance/UV/materials, skins, source-prefab immutability/idempotence, ownership tags and post-U10 GUID preservation.

pitchFinding.problem: During toolkit publication, local pitch divides by unchecked existing WorldVoxelSize. Zero/nonfinite old world pitch or new recipe pitch can invalidate metadata only after an asset has been changed.
pitchFinding.currentArtifactScope: U10 current valid bake is not claimed corrupt.
pitchFinding.fix: ConvertedLocalPitch validates finite positive input/output and calculates with a double intermediate during preparation, before mesh creation/publication; publication assigns the prevalidated value.
